title: Reimagining Graph Classification from a Prototype View with Optimal Transport: Algorithm and Theorem

problem.claim: Graph classification with GNNs may lose structural information and lacks sufficient transparency.

gap.claim: The standard GNN-based classification design limits the diversity of intra-class representations by assuming that each class is represented by a single vector.

narrative_sequence.summary: GNNs have achieved inspiring performance in graph classification.
GNN message passing may cause loss of structural information.
GNN-based graph classification has limited transparency because its decision process resembles a black box.
The following non-linear classifier assumes a single vector per class, limiting intra-class representation diversity.
